notes:
What's new in this update:
- Portal Download page now uses Financial Year (e.g. 2025-26) instead of a plain calendar year, matching every other GST page in the app.
- GSTR-2B Tally Import: when a row shows "Missing Ledger", you can now pick any existing Tally ledger directly from the Preview Grid, or click "Create Ledger" at the end of the row to create it in Tally on the spot (name + GSTIN pre-filled from the invoice) — no more manual detour into Tally.
- New module: GSTR-1 Tally Import (Tally Suite). Upload your GSTR-1 JSON, set your Sales/CGST/SGST/IGST ledgers once in Settings, review the preview, and post Sales entries straight into Tally — same missing-ledger fix-in-place tools as GSTR-2B.
